name: Piperazine Citrate Anhydrous
summary: According to a small computer model rather than tests on people, Piperazine Citrate Anhydrous received a low risk score of 12 for liver problems and a low risk score of 3 for heart issues [M]. The available records from PubChem list no specific warning signs or known problems for this drug [1]. Additional data from ChEMBL also shows no recorded warning signs or issues for this medication [2].
